---
name: Bug report
about: Something in a skill document or script is wrong, broken, or outdated
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Where is the problem?

- File: `.agents/skills/production-engineering/topics/NNN-slug.md` (or script/workflow path)
- Section/line:

## What is wrong?

The incorrect claim, in your words, quoted if short.

## What is correct?

The right behavior, with a source (RFC / official docs / paper / tool output):

## How to reproduce / verify

Steps, commands, or links.

## Severity

- [ ] CRITICAL — dangerously insecure/wrong guidance
- [ ] HIGH — materially misleading
- [ ] MEDIUM — imprecise but not harmful

## Environment (for scripts/CI)

OS, Python version, commit SHA.
